label: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in s- or g-initial sequences after c/d/o/f (weak, uncaptured)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.06% of steps) that fires only during the original phase (t>=2) and on the <DEL> step, never during the copy phase. Rate rises with position and with L. It is strongly enriched when the sequence starts with s or g (about 73% of mass), when the previous one or two inputs are c/d/o/f, and when the current input is e/v/d/t/<DEL>. Activations often form runs of 2-4 consecutive steps near the end of the original sequence. No token-level predicate gets precision above about 13%: the best F1 on dev was 0.17, and the broad s/g-first predicate gets mass recall 0.67 but precision 0.04. So the trigger is some specific hidden-state configuration that these variables do not capture. Magnitude was not characterised beyond the fact that the top quartile is somewhat more concentrated in s/g-initial sequences (85% coverage vs 62% in the bottom quartile).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=s (+5.63), orig0=g (+5.15), prev_tok=c (+4.03), prev_tok=o (+3.80), prev_tok=d (+3.77), prev2_tok=o (+3.44). Lower it: phase=2 (-6.09), orig1=c (-3.49), orig1=f (-3.35), in_tok=s (-3.18).
